newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ICICI Bank 96/97 1st half net at 203.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: India's ICICI Bank 96/97 1st half net at 203.9 mln.

text.p: India's private ICICI Banking Corp Ltd said it posted a net profit of 203.9 million rupees for the first six months of 1996/97 (April-March), up from 47.7 milllion rupees during the year-ago period.
Advances during the first six months amounted to 6.89 billion rupees, up from 4.39 billion rupees in the year-ago period, the bank said, releasing its unaudited results.
The bank, a subsidiary of term-lending institution ICICI , said interest expense during the half year amounted to 620 million rupees, up from 335.9 million in year-ago period.
Deposits during the six months rose to 10.94 billion rupees, up from 6.14 billion during the year-ago period.
Provisions including tax amounted to 111.9 million rupees, up from 25.7 million rupees during the year-ago period. The bank has a paid up capital of 1.5 billion rupees.
